problem:

$$
a=⟨1,2⟩.

Question 2
?

The acceleration a at time t of a particle P moving in the xy-plane is given by a=⟨1,2⟩. Given that the particle has velocity v=⟨4,3⟩ when t=1, calculate the velocity vector of P at time t.

a
v=⟨t+3,2t+1⟩
b
v=⟨t+4,2t+3⟩
c
v=⟨3t+1,4t+2⟩
d
v=⟨2t+4,4t+2⟩
e
v=⟨4t+3,3t+1⟩
Submit
